intro.summary: North-central community around Edmonton Trail NE and the Winston Heights golf course, where older bungalows are rebuilt as single and semi-detached infills.
intro.body: Winston Heights/Mountview straddles Edmonton Trail NE north of 16 Avenue, around the Winston Heights golf course. Its mid-century bungalows on generous lots attract both new single-detached homes and side-by-side semi-detached infills.
